answer: The design leans on homomorphic encryption for private computation. By the vine of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the fable of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short.
